attempts.summary: Installed and configured a persistent iptables host firewall on node1 (Alpine Linux): SSH (TCP/22) allowed from any address, TCP/9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.142.11), and TCP/9000 rejected (TCP RST) from node3 and everywhere else. Rules were saved via /etc/init.d/iptables save and the iptables service enabled in the default OpenRC runlevel for boot persistence. Functional connectivity tests confirmed correct allow/reject behavior both before and after restarting all three managed nodes one at a time; each node's boot identity changed and services recovered healthy after its restart.
